summary.en: Getting started as a parts list: a bill-of-materials table of 1–3 rows with BOM balloons, then a chain of 2–5 chips (the first steps) under a THEN label, and a note.
summary.zh: 把“如何开始”画成零件表：1–3 行的物料清单，带零件编号气泡；下面一个“然后”标签引出 2–5 个步骤芯片连成的链，再加一行注。

fits: The install / getting-started sheet near the end of a blueprint film.
notFor: More than three commands; commands longer than 60 characters; products without a command line.

intent.en: Tell a developer exactly what to fetch and do first, in the drawing office's own form: a parts list.
intent.zh: 用制图室自己的形式告诉开发者先拿什么、做什么：一张零件表。

content.en: Title, two heads, 1–3 rows (code ≤ 60), a then label, 2–5 chips (≤ 16), a note.
content.zh: 标题、两个表头、1–3 行（代码 ≤ 60）、“然后”标签、2–5 个芯片（≤ 6 字）、一行注。

fits.zh: blueprint 片子临近结尾的安装 / 快速开始图。

notFor.zh: 超过三条命令；超过 60 字符的命令；没有命令行的产品。

en: Rows are code: keep them Latin; only the heads, chips and note translate.
zh: 行是代码，保持拉丁字符；只翻译表头、芯片和注。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
